subject: Subprocessor churn: ops playbook and verification request
messages:
From: EdgeStream Ops <ops@edgestream.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planned provider rotation - notice and verification

Neha / Connor,

Heads up: EdgeStream is planning a provider rotation on July 15 that will move a subset of CDN and telemetry forwarding functions to a new subcontractor (EdgeRelay Partners). Per our DPA appendix, we wanted to provide notice and the roster so your security/privacy team can confirm whether additional evidence or controls are required.

Summary:
- Affected processing: aggregated telemetry + edge caching (no customer PII at rest)
- New subcontractor: EdgeRelay Partners (EU-based)
- Proposed change effective: 2026-07-15

Attached: edgestream_subproc_notice_20260630.pdf (pdf) — formal notice and minimal scope matrix.

Please confirm whether this requires an addendum or any immediate mitigation from Redwood. FinPay (our mutual customer) asked us to loop you in for verification.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Operations Lead, EdgeStream
ops@edgestream.io

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: EdgeStream Ops <ops@edgestream.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned provider rotation - notice and verification

Samir,

Thanks for the heads up and the notice. Quick Qs so we can triage: 
1) Does EdgeRelay have access to KV caches or any token-level telemetry?
2) Which regions will traffic be routed through (EU only, or fallback to us/us-west)?
3) Do you have their SOC 2 / security questionnaire results and a list of subprocessor locations?

Operational ask: please send a short evidence bundle (certificate snapshots, contact for SOC attestation, and a CSV roster) — we've included a brief ops playbook template below that our PM/ops team will use to capture required mitigations. If you can get that to us by EOD Thursday (7/2), we can respond to FinPay and decide if a DPA addendum is required.

Ops playbook (what we need from you):
- Exact services impacted and API endpoints
- Access scope (read/write, tokens, caches)
- Data residency per region
- SOC 2 / ISO/attestation links
- Emergency contact and escalation path
- Proposed rollback window and fallback region

Connor / Kimberly / Marissa — looping you for any additional control asks or legal escalation.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, EdgeStream Ops <ops@edgestream.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned provider rotation - notice and verification

Thanks Neha / Samir. Two immediate control items from our side: 
- If EdgeRelay will ever see request-level identifiers (even hashed), we require proof of key management and separation of logs for EU routing.
- For fallback routing outside EU, we need confirmation that customer tenant data is not persisted outside the agreed region.

Samir — can you attach:
- EdgeRelay SOC 2 summary (or equivalent)
- Network flow diagram showing EU-only egress path for FinPay tenants
- Any SLA changes for cache invalidation or purge APIs

If those are not available, we will likely require a provisional onshore mirror or escrow for FinPay while we complete validation.

Kimberly Park
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: EdgeStream Ops <ops@edgestream.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned provider rotation - notice and verification

Neha / Kimberly,

Apologies — earlier bundle was light. Attached: subprocessor_evidence_manifest.xlsx (spreadsheet) and a SOC 2 summary PDF (will follow via secure link). Quick answers inline:
- Access: EdgeRelay will receive aggregated telemetry only; no token-level KV or decrypted content will be transferred.
- Regions: Primary EU (Frankfurt), with a fallback route to us-east for failover only.
- SLA: no change to purge APIs; cache TTLs remain configurable by tenant.

We also provided a short network map in the spreadsheet. If you want a temporary onshore mirror, we can stand up an escrow for FinPay but this will add 4-6 weeks.

Samir Patel
Operations Lead, EdgeStream

Attachment: subprocessor_evidence_manifest.xlsx (xlsx)

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: EdgeStream Ops <ops@edgestream.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Price <laura.price@finpay.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planned provider rotation - notice and verification — Redwood response and action items

Team,

Summary and next steps after internal review:
- Risk posture: acceptable with conditional mitigations. EdgeRelay's EU-only processing and the lack of token-level access significantly reduces scope.
- Required evidence (EdgeStream to provide by 7/9):
  1) SOC 2 attestation copy or auditor contact (PDF or secure link)
  2) Signed subprocessor addendum (limited scope) or confirmation that existing DPA covers the change
  3) Network flow map exported to PDF showing EU-only egress for FinPay tenant IDs

Temporary mitigations:
- For FinPay: offer optional onshore mirror while we validate (cost estimate to be provided by EdgeStream).
- Redwood will add a conditional routing rule for FinPay that pins traffic to EU endpoints until evidence is confirmed.

Marissa / Connor: please capture costs and routing config in the shared doc. Laura: looping you so FinPay sees the proposed mitigations and timeline.

Neha Kapoor
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: edgestream_subproc_notice_20260630.pdf, subprocessor_evidence_manifest.xlsx
